name: controle-estoque
description: Sistema ERP de Controle de Estoque — Monorepo (Backend + Frontend + Mobile)

scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../mobile && npm install --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build
